teacher_logits: A instantaneous r/.2; B exact Q4/.2; neither includes student prior
memory_write: omega=.2*c*u(selected); normalized convex memory; no forced observation reset
observation: native continuous cxcywh slot1 always retained, no IoU dedup; outside fixed Strong inactive readout stays ERef
geometry_source: native teacher box exclusively; no mask threshold component or bounding box

transform.fit: axiswise weighted least squares: scale=cov(x,y)/var(x); delta=mean_y-scale*mean_x
transform.unreliable: side invalid; no scale clipping, no translation-only fallback; fully off-image boxes invalid

reliability: same source-mask return-cycle soft Dice; observed r=1 is no-transport not correctness
link: same v0 occupancy*transported mask supports and fixed Source adjacent weights; no box-boundary generation
reference_policy: frozen_instantaneous_softmax((u+.25*link+.1*memorycos-.1G)/.2), no student prior or learned phi
return_reward: rho_t=active_t*(u+.25*link+.1*memorycos-.1G); no extra confidence multiplier inside return
return_definition: force current candidate, then exact expectation over up to three future discrete reference actions; sum undiscounted, no division byH, truncate atT
inactive_start: Q all zero and only E valid; active-start rollout traversing inactive uses rho0, advances previous E, no memory write
reference_gradients: all reference probabilities, branch memories, teacher distribution and incoming soft student histories differentiate in Direct
OPD: two current-student hard histories refreshed once each outer round; teacher/features fixed for up to10 inner steps
FixedKD: two teacher histories sampled once at initialization and fixed for all outer/inner fits
Direct: two full soft histories recomputed every inner step; same outer Gumbel pair reused within round; full available gradient
